The product, its version and build, the open-source notices, the optional Powered by badge, and Copy diagnostics. The Powered by badge is off by default.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    **Drop-in.** `doctor` (`doctorFlow`): the SDK, the product's version and channel, the server, the
    device id, the token store, discovery, the services, the license, and any feature this device
    cannot use. The theme's `poweredBy` adds the Powered by Polaris Key line.

    **Styled part.** `tableRows`.

    **Headless.** None of its own: `doctor --json` returns the same facts.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
